test.name: Ask for the FamilySearch ID when the message names a person but gives no PID
test.description: A project always starts from a FamilySearch person ID (lead, 2026-10-15). init-project no longer searches by name, so a message naming a person without an ID must create NOTHING and ask for the ID, naming the person as the user described them.

input.delegation:
init-project: Start a new research project. I want to find the parents of Patrick Flynn, born around 1845 in Ireland, who lived in Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania. I don't have his FamilySearch ID.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Must NOT call person_search — init-project no longer has that tool and never searches by name
Must NOT call project_create — no project is created without a FamilySearch person ID
Must ask the researcher for Patrick Flynn's FamilySearch person ID in its return
Should name the person as the user described them (Patrick Flynn, b. ~1845 Ireland, Schuylkill County) so the researcher knows which ID is wanted
Must not invent, guess or stub a person in place of the ID
